sentiment.reasoning: Negative skew driven by analyst commentary flagging margin compression risk in the O2C segment, partially offset by positive retail-segment same-store-sales chatter.

conflict_flag.description: Price momentum agent classifies MILDLY_BULLISH while sentiment agent classifies MILDLY_NEGATIVE on the same instrument at the same timestamp.
conflict_flag.synthesis_layer_expected_behavior: Do not average the two into a false neutral. Surface both classifications with their independent confidence scores, cite the source disagreement explicitly, and lower the overall recommendation confidence rather than silently picking one side.
